blocks.prompt: 3. The population of a town is 4084101 at present and five years ago it was 3200000. Find its rate of increase if it increased geometrically.
blocks.explanation:
"Increased geometrically" ka matlab hai ke abaadi har saal ek hi number \(1 + r\) se multiply hoti rahi, yani har saal ki abaadi G.P. banati hai. Yahan humein shuru ki qeemat (5 saal pehle) aur aakhri qeemat (aaj) di gayi hai, aur rate dhoondna hai.
Plan: G.P. ke term ki equation banayenge, \((1 + r)^5\) alag karenge, phir woh number dhoondenge jis ki 5th power yeh ho, aur aakhir mein percentage mein likhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 5 saal pehle: 3200000; aaj: 4084101; growth geometric.
Humein find karna hai: saalana rate of increase \(r\).
Tareeqa: G.P. ka term: 5 saal baad qeemat \(a_1(1 + r)^5\), kyunke har saal ek factor \(1 + r\) lagta hai.

Equation banayein
\[3200000(1 + r)^5 = 4084101\]
Kyun: 5 saal pehle wali abaadi pehla term hai. Har saal ek factor \(1 + r\) lagta hai, aur 5 saal mein 5 factors, is liye \(3200000(1 + r)^5\) aaj ki abaadi ke barabar hai.

\((1 + r)^5\) ko alag karein
\[(1 + r)^5 = \dfrac{4084101}{3200000}\]
\[= 1.2762815625\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 3200000 se divide kiya taake \((1 + r)^5\) akela reh jaye. Yeh division bilkul poora aata hai, decimal khatam ho jata hai, jo ishara hai ke rate koi saaf number hoga.

\(1 + r\) nikalein
\[(1.05)^2 = 1.1025\]
\[(1.05)^4 = 1.21550625\]
\[(1.05)^5 = 1.2762815625\]
\[1 + r = 1.05\]
Kyun: Humein woh number chahiye jis ki 5th power 1.2762815625 ho (yani 5th root). Calculator ho to seedha nikal lein; warna andaza lagayein: abaadi 5 saal mein taqreeban 28% barhi, to har saal 5% ke qareeb. 1.05 ki powers nikaleen to 5th power bilkul barabar aayi.

Rate ko percentage mein likhein
\[r = 1.05 - 1 = 0.05\]
\[= \dfrac{5}{100} = 5\%\]
Kyun: \(1 + r = 1.05\) se 1 ghataya to \(r = 0.05\), aur 100 se multiply kar ke 5%.
Tasdeeq: \(3200000 \times 1.2762815625 = 4084101\), bilkul aaj ki abaadi.
